verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no TFLOPS or TOPS figures tied to a stated precision or sparsity mode. The vendor page offers only a relative marketing claim ('up to 2.2X the AI performance vs. competitive accelerators') and lists supported datatypes (MXFP6/MXFP4) without per-precision throughput. Community analysis says the chip 'holds a lead across many data types in matrix math' but quotes no numbers, so an engineer could not size workloads from this pack.
